Dallas Mavericks owner Mark Cuban has disclosed how much he personally owns in meme cryptocurrency Dogecoin (CRYPTO: DOGE).

What Happened: Cuban, a big advocate of Dogecoin and other cryptocurrencies, said on Twitter that he personally owns $494 worth of Dogecoin. https://t.co/prRorZNYMp
